title: How would you feel about a game if AI was only used for coding?
author: Any_Confection_7137
selftext:
Hi everyone, I have a question. How would you feel about a game if the developer used AI, **but** all the assets, sounds, images, and so on were made entirely by hand, and AI was only used to help write the game's mechanics scripts?  
Here is the deal: I want to make a game. I am pretty good at Blender and 3ds Max, and I’m decent at Photoshop. However, I am very weak at coding. I already have a complete story and plot ready.  
I’m asking honestly: would you consider this game "AI slop" if **only** the code was written with the help of AI?

comments.author: mellamofionaa
comments.body:
I think we’re in a weird time where AI and artists is very polarizing but ai in coding is very normalized. Personally I think this belief will change with time and exposure. 

A friend of mine made all the art assets in this game and then built it with vibe coding!

https://bash.tv/dudutorres/temp

Our Bash community is a mix of artists and devs playing with ai. Let me know if you’d like to check it out!

comments.author: Entropydemic
comments.body:
I'm all about using Ai tools. I love art and love video games so to me the use of Ai tools is just a slightly easier way of doing the same things.

For example broken code links in long lines of code are much quicker to diagnose than by eye. It's a special treat of the code or assets are yours, but if the game is good no one bothers to measure the difference.

comments.author: affabledrunk
comments.body: This is not the forum for this kind of rumination man. Show us what you're doing with AI and don't worry about the zealots, they gonna hate on you whatever you do. The good news is that all this ai hate will come crumbling down pretty soon i believe.

replies.author: Nooberling
replies.body:
It's going to get a lot worse before it gets better.

The solid core of AI hate in the US is socioeconomic discontent. All the rage of working harder than people are designed to work for not quite enough has been bubbling for twenty years. A generation worse off economically than its parents is not something American culture can handle very well.

replies.author: Bluetails_Buizel
replies.body: Yep, got banned from their main sub for submitting my game, even the admin have strong bias

comments.author: doudou262
comments.body: No. "AI slop" usually means low-effort, mass-generated filler. Using AI to help you write mechanics when art, sound, and story are handmade is just using a tool to fill a skill gap. Most players care if the game is fun and cohesive, not how you debugged your scripts. Be honest about it if asked, but don't let fear stop you

comments.author: Defiant-Diet-485
comments.body:
It’s subjective, but to me “AI slop” is more about low-effort, mass-produced, barely curated content than simply using AI.

If someone has a good seed/idea, gives it strong direction/parameters, steers it and actually refines the result, I think AI can be a genuinely interesting creative tool, especially when it lets someone make something they otherwise couldn’t. I always think of it like a focused fishing in the eather. Pulling into the normal world what is otherwise inaccessable.

So no, I definitely wouldn’t call a game AI slop just because AI helped write the code.

comments.author: Officialpolygrafix
comments.body:
1. I might be wrong, but I don't think anyone in here has a problem with Ai being used in games.   
2. i'm currently doing just that. Im a 24 year game developer- Artist and designer.  Expert in 3ds max and photoshop, and am doing all my own game art and animation, but using claude through mcp to code it. I have to say it's working great.  However, I posted up my game to the "tycoon" game dev group on reddit here, and i got such harsh backlash, because they required an ai content disclosure, and they didn't even read through what i wrote, they just saw the phrase "ai content disclosure" and went ballistic. I had to explain that i was creating all the art in the game, but they didn't care.   
The fact that i used suno to make music tracks, and grok as a voice over (it did a really good job actually) and that i had chat gpt draw concept art for characters, (because ultimately it's quick and better than what i would produce actually as my speciality is 3d, not concept art-although im capable, its just better), and that im coding with claude, they just all went ballistic.   

So just be careful where you post. Someone had told me "read the room" which i didn't do before i posted. but literally have had stalkers pursuing me and trying to downvote anything i say afterward, even in other groups.    
I get the push back against slop of any kind, but man.. some people.. They are just terrrible human beings

replies.author: cowman3456
replies.body:
Sorry that happened to you.  I feel this.  I feel it every time I see a dev get shit on for the same reasons.  These zealots are idiots without a concept of how deeply involved making a game is.  They're not intelligent enough to avoid grouping every use of AI into a slop bucket.  That's just not reality.  

This type of hate for other devs using AI, in any way, is so close to racism, that it's scary.  

Getting out the pitchforks is a strong sign of low intelligence and herd mentality.  It's a crying shame that people have to fear this type of brainless response when sharing their passions.

comments.author: mccoypauley
comments.body: Your zealot critics are not reasonable people. If you use it in any capacity, they will call it slop. Even though they themselves use AI in some capacity (whether they're aware of it or not). Hypocrisy has never phased them, and they allergic to nuance. Just make the game. They will go away eventually.

comments.author: fluxtah
comments.body:
If it looks good, plays good I don't mind. Been coding for 40 years (that includes my childhood! around 20+ years pro).

Only thing I would say is if the person creating the game does not know how to code, its still not an issue for me though I would caution that its a black box no one understands. Despite that if it passes all tests to call it a shippable product then I don't see a massive issue.

comments.author: Saikatai
comments.body: like almost all the games out right now?

comments.author: SpookyRockjaw
comments.body: You're on the AI game dev reddit my man

comments.author: bonsoir-world
comments.body:
AI to assist with or compliment work flows and existing skillsets = Good

AI to build something you have zero experience in or to entirely generate (steal) art work and art styles with nothing but a prompt = Bad 

As always there’s exclusions to the rule and some caveats, naturally but at a high level that’s how it is and should be. 

People right now though aren’t seeing between the lines. They’re mad a machine can spit out art in style they’ve spent their lives crafting, they’re scared it’s removing the need for jobs and processes that ultimately cost people their livelihoods. Eventually people will realise it’s here to stay and we’ll all move on but for now, you can appreciate how great it is and understand people’s concerns. 

Just do you.

comments.author: AvengerDr
comments.body:
Depends on how much help you get. That means, is it entirely vibe coded and you have no background in Computer Science / SWE? Very likely to be slop.

Or, dod you let the AI decide the gameplay mechanics and you simply approved everything? High potential to be slop, as you outsourced the game to an LLM's taste.

Did you tell the AI explicitly what to do because you do have formal background in CS/SWE? Maybe not slop, but depends on the scale of the project.

comments.author: discardthemold
comments.body: Frankly I'd be more impressed that an AI made a game than a person.

comments.author: EC36339
comments.body:
AI generally does better at things you are good at.

If you are bad at coding, use an existing engine. Or bring along a willingness to learn coding, at least on a high level. Replace "or" with "and". You are not inherently bad at coding. Everything can be learned by anyone, and AI is incredibly helpful with that.
